decisions.reason: Although it was given its own page in 2019, this consumer-facing drink mix is the least central to the firm's industrial sustainability direction, so management has less strategic and public commitment to justify and is more willing to redeploy resources.

These modular waste-to-energy extensions fit the established business closely, and in a growing R&D-intensive firm management is likely to continue them despite only modest public commitment because they can still be framed as part of the core platform.

The waste-oil-to-energy plant received the strongest visible commitment with its own pages and a public launch statement, so escalation of commitment makes management likely to persist and justify the investment as strategically important.

The plastic-waste-to-fuel plant is close to the firm's established offer and was elevated to its own page by 2019, so prior investment and public positioning make management more likely to continue than to withdraw it.
